parent_objective: audit revised outcome semantics materialization before execution or instrumentation design
blocked_by: explicit unsupported metric gaps must be audited before rerun
supersedes: direct revised semantics execution without preflight audit

public_gates: M1744 must audit M1743 materialization counts and guardrails
M1744 must audit unsupported metric gaps before any new rollout
M1744 must decide instrumentation design bounded-panel design branch synthesis or stop
M1744 must not run environment rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout change actor inputs tune profiles rank controller families or claim paper-level evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat unsupported metric gaps as covered
do not treat unsupported faults as covered

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits no-rollout semantics materialization and chooses route around explicit metric gaps

stop_condition: stop if M1743 artifacts are missing
stop if unsupported metric gaps are treated as covered
stop if audit admits rollout without instrumentation/bounded-panel decision
stop if audit ranks controller-family profiles
fallback_plan: route to instrumentation design if metric gaps block fair execution
route to bounded-panel design if benchmark rows can be evaluated with supported metrics
route to branch synthesis if the scenario taxonomy branch needs a broader decision

blocked_shortcuts: do not claim paper-level or level3 self-identification evidence
allowed_updates: M1744 status queue scoreboard research log and review
